newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends sharply higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends sharply higher in quiet trade.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended sharply higher on Friday but prices were trapped in tight ranges as traders digested recent volatility and waited for OPEC's meeting next week in Vienna.
"It was very light volume," said one broker. "It's cold still and there are forecasts for more cold so it has an influence in the market."
But gas oil's gains were largely seen as catching up to the late rally on Thursday and not to any fresh impetus today.
Also, the standoff between AIC and Cargill over deliveries against the Nov contract was still quieting trade.
Trading house AIC, the main short on the Nov contract, said on Friday that Cargill, the main long, was behind on its nominations for the second five-day delivery window.
Dec gas oil ended $3.75 higher at $222.75 a tonne after straying in a $2 range the entire day.
At 1818 GMT, Jan Brent was up 23 cents at $23.36 a barrel, helped by strength in the cash market.
